edits.text: - If the left-side stretch is read alone, is it a coherent, self-contained proposition? It is most severe when the cut falls between two tokens that are parts of the same multi-word personal name or when it separates a personal name from an immediately following appositive or title, since those splits leave a referent fragment and break cohesion; it is mildest when the left side is a complete independent clause, a true appositive or clearly parenthetical phrase that preserves truth when isolated, or when the cut merely separates coordinate list items or other clearly independent nominal elements.
edits._was: - If the left-side stretch is read alone, is it a coherent, self-contained proposition? The worst are fragments that lack a diagnosable main predicate or identity of agent when isolated; the mildest are independent clauses, appositives, or clearly parenthetical material that preserve truth when isolated.

edits.text: If two candidates both split the same multi-word personal name, prefer the cut that keeps the entire name unbroken (place the full name on one side).
edits._was: - When one marker detaches a relative clause from its head noun and another splits inside that relative clause, prefer the cut inside the relative clause.

edits.text: If two candidates both split the same multi-word personal name, prefer the cut that keeps the entire name unbroken (place the full name on one side).

- Is the marker placed between tokens that are part of the same contiguous multi-word personal name, or between a personal name and its immediately following appositive/title? Binding: keep the entire name together with any immediately attached appositive/title on one side (a true split of adjacent name tokens is the most severe); mildest when the marker only separates a detachable honorific or clearly parenthetical material.
